source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check any mechanical problem found during assemble the storage adapter.

1. Install M.2 controllers to M.2 PCIe slot
2. Check if any mechanical problems can be found, such as: plug/unplug too tight or too loose; mechanical interference issues with chassis cover.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. All the M.2 controllers can be plugged into system chassis smoothly without mechanical issues

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Physical/visual M.2 seat, bracket and screw inspection requires an operator.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO; correctly identifies physical fit and visual inspection as non-remote work.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED; adds exact slot/hardware identity, safe power-off, stop-on-resistance and evidence requirements.

historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No exact standalone handoff was found beyond the consolidated sequence; the classification is consistent with the physical core.

original_test_intent: Verify by hands-on assembly that every specified M.2 controller, adapter, retention part and chassis cover fits the intended slot without excessive insertion/removal force, looseness, misalignment, connector damage or mechanical interference.
original_method: A qualified hardware operator powers the system safe, maps each M.2 device/adapter/slot, inspects orientation and hardware, installs and removes each combination using the assembly SOP, judges force/retention/clearance and records photos and findings including chassis-cover closure.
manual_activity: Installation/removal, tactile judgment of tightness/looseness and visual inspection of alignment, clearance and cover interference are the core acceptance activities. The agent can prepare the matrix and analyze supplied images but cannot perform or claim the physical observations.
required_inputs: Exact M.2 controller/model/form factor, adapter/bracket/fasteners and intended PCIe/M.2 slot mapping
Chassis/cover revision and approved assembly procedure including screw/torque requirements
Powered-off or vendor-defined safe service state and ESD controls
Qualified operator and agreed qualitative/quantitative force, retention and clearance criteria
Required photo angles, identifiers and exception-report format
safety_requirements: De-energize and service the platform exactly as the hardware SOP requires; use ESD controls.
Verify keying, orientation, standoff and fastener before insertion; never force a connector or close a cover against interference.
Stop on abnormal resistance, looseness, skew, damaged contacts, wrong standoff, crushed component or cover contact.
Preserve the as-found condition and evidence; do not repeatedly insert a suspect part or attempt unapproved bending/grinding.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare the device-slot-adapter checklist and safe-state/evidence requirements.
Receive operator-attributed photos, measurements and comments and correlate them with exact hardware identities.
Summarize mechanical exceptions and completeness as Tool Result without claiming the physical check or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the assembly matrix and physical acceptance criteria.
Perform and attest every insertion/removal, tactile assessment and visual clearance inspection.
Decide disposition of any interference or fit issue and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No software command can measure connector feel, seating or chassis interference; its manual boundary is correct.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Do not substitute OS enumeration for mechanical acceptance. Read-only inventory after assembly may be supplemental but cannot prove smooth fit.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Physical install, tight/loose and cover-interference checks plus 5/0-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a slot-by-slot operator checklist with device/adapter/chassis identifiers, calibrated go/no-go or force criteria where the owner defines them, standardized photos and separate electrical enumeration after safe reassembly.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact chassis, motherboard/adapter and M.2 mechanical stack-up.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record mechanical revisions, BOM/assembly-SOP revision and fastener specification.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project mechanical drawings and assembly/service SOP must define clearances and force/torque limits.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds traceable matrix, criteria and evidence while retaining hands-on fit inspection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; tactile and cover-clearance checks remain manual and mandatory.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Mechanical acceptance specification and hardware matrix.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Photos may miss insertion force or intermittent interference; operator attestation remains necessary.

project_override_considerations: A project may define its installed M.2 population and measurable torque/clearance limits. Unpopulated combinations must be reported as outside that plan, not silently counted as tested.
expected_evidence: Controller/adapter/slot/chassis/fastener matrix, revisions, SOP and operator identity
Safe power/ESD state and before/after connector/part photographs
Per-combination insertion/removal force judgment, retention, alignment, clearance and cover-closure findings
Any damage/interference stop, supplemental enumeration if approved, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion consistently require smooth physical M.2 installation without mechanical issues.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The physical acceptance intent is clear. Missing hardware or criteria are readiness inputs; the tactile/visual core is MANUAL ONLY rather than BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with the physical-only boundary and expands the evidence beyond generic seating.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with MANUAL ONLY and retains safe-state, identity and stop-on-resistance controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds chassis-cover closure, exact combination coverage and prevents electrical enumeration from substituting for mechanical fit.

review_improvement: Creates auditable per-combination mechanical evidence and explicit damage-prevention stops while keeping human observation ownership clear.
independent_technical_reasoning: The tested properties are force, looseness, alignment and physical interference. They cannot be established through package supply, logs or remote commands, so the core remains MANUAL ONLY even though the agent can organize evidence.
